ontario-social-studies-g1-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Social Studies Grade 1 - Overall Expectations
ontario-social-studies-g1-all-strands.documentVersion: Ontario Social Studies, History, and Geography Curriculum (2026)

standards.unit: Heritage and Identity: Our Changing Roles and Responsibilities
standards.strand: Heritage and Identity: Our Changing Roles and Responsibilities
standards.summaryText: describe some of the ways in which people’s roles, relationships with, and responsibilities to others and the world around them relate to who they are and what their situation is, and how and why changes in circumstances might affect people’s roles, relationships, and responsibilities as well as their sense of self
standards.officialOutcomeText: describe some of the ways in which people’s roles, relationships with, and responsibilities to others and the world around them relate to who they are and what their situation is, and how and why changes in circumstances might affect people’s roles, relationships, and responsibilities as well as their sense of self
standards.curriculumFocus: Heritage and Identity: Our Changing Roles and Responsibilities

standards.unit: Heritage and Identity: Our Changing Roles and Responsibilities
standards.strand: Heritage and Identity: Our Changing Roles and Responsibilities
standards.summaryText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate some aspects of the interrelationship between their identity/sense of self, their different roles, relationships, and responsibilities, and various situations in their daily lives
standards.officialOutcomeText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate some aspects of the interrelationship between their identity/sense of self, their different roles, relationships, and responsibilities, and various situations in their daily lives
standards.curriculumFocus: Heritage and Identity: Our Changing Roles and Responsibilities

standards.unit: Heritage and Identity: Our Changing Roles and Responsibilities
standards.strand: Heritage and Identity: Our Changing Roles and Responsibilities
standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding that they and other people experience a range of different roles, relationships, and responsibilities, and that all people should be treated with respect, regardless of their roles, relationships, and responsibilities
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding that they and other people experience a range of different roles, relationships, and responsibilities, and that all people should be treated with respect, regardless of their roles, relationships, and responsibilities
standards.curriculumFocus: Heritage and Identity: Our Changing Roles and Responsibilities

standards.unit: People and Environments: The Local Community
standards.strand: People and Environments: The Local Community
standards.summaryText: describe some aspects of the interrelationship between people and the natural and built features of their community, with a focus on how the features of and services in the community meet people’s needs
standards.officialOutcomeText: describe some aspects of the interrelationship between people and the natural and built features of their community, with a focus on how the features of and services in the community meet people’s needs
standards.curriculumFocus: People and Environments: The Local Community

standards.unit: People and Environments: The Local Community
standards.strand: People and Environments: The Local Community
standards.summaryText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate some aspects of the interrelationship between people and different natural and built features of their local community, with a focus on significant short- and long-term effects of this interrelationship
standards.officialOutcomeText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate some aspects of the interrelationship between people and different natural and built features of their local community, with a focus on significant short- and long-term effects of this interrelationship
standards.curriculumFocus: People and Environments: The Local Community

standards.unit: People and Environments: The Local Community
standards.strand: People and Environments: The Local Community
standards.summaryText: describe significant aspects of their community, with reference to different areas, services, and natural and built features, demonstrating an understanding of some basic ways of describing location and measuring distance
standards.officialOutcomeText: describe significant aspects of their community, with reference to different areas, services, and natural and built features, demonstrating an understanding of some basic ways of describing location and measuring distance
standards.curriculumFocus: People and Environments: The Local Community
